references.text: Describes the casting of gold rings for the ark, illustrating the consistent use of gold in the furnishings of the sanctuary
Describes five acacia wood pillars for the curtain at the entrance of the tent, with a similar construction featuring pillars and hooks made of gold
Refers to pillars with silver bases in the courtyard, using the same type of construction with metal bases
A parallel text describing the execution of this commandment - four acacia wood pillars overlaid with gold and fitted with silver bases
Describes how Moses set up the curtain to shield the ark of the testimony, fulfilling the instruction
Refers to the curtain that separated the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place in the tabernacle
